notes.title: Bouncers code has been FULLY RECOVERED after 2 years!
notes.content:
[p]Bouncers code has been FULLY RECOVERED after 2 years![/p][p]Huge thanks to Pinko and Altered for helping recover everything![/p][p]I had to re-add all text, fix errors, and it took a few days but Bouncers is BACK![/p][p]Bouncers will still be free with no in-app purchases[/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]Fixed bug where resolution is set to the lowest when opening the settings for the first time[/p][p]Fixed bug where volume doesn't persist after closing the game[/p][p]Changes:
Max volume reduced to -5db[/p][p][/p][p]I can add anything to the game now, so if you have any suggestions join my discord![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/EsfKMEXBKy"]https://discord.gg/EsfKMEXBKy[/url][/p]

notes.title: Bouncers will be FREE!
notes.content:
Bouncers will soon be FREE!

Why?
I feel like this game has reached it's peak, and its time to let everyone else enjoy the game now

What about people who bought it?
Well, unfortunately nothing, I would give a free skin or something similar, but I don't have updated Unity files anymore, but thank you for the support.

notes.title: September Discount!
notes.content:
Bouncers has come a long way and its time to have some more people be able to try it, More is coming soon, and I'm learning 3D. Multiplayer will not be added due to it being an absolute pain to implement so I dropped the price and now it is ON SALE! Enjoy!

Cheers,
Kreis
